imd2025.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

greenspace_access.title: Access to green space in England 2024 (corrected May 2025)
greenspace_access.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
greenspace_access.geography: Census 2021 Output Area records with LSOA 2021 and MSOA 2021 lookup codes; aggregate household counts to obtain LSOA rates
greenspace_access.measure: Percentage of households with access, using walkable street/path network distances; official statistics in development.

scenarios.1: Green space of at least 2 ha within 1000 m, including woodland, nature reserves and open-access land

greenspace_access.note: Use the corrected May 2025 workbook: the Scenario 5 national result was corrected from 53% to 33%. The compressed workbook is about 35 MB but its XML exceeds 1 GB; stream selected sheets. Compare custom routing cautiously because the official analysis uses household origins and a broader greenspace inventory.

os_greenspace.title: OS Open Greenspace
os_greenspace.attribution: Contains Ordnance Survey data © Crown copyright and database right 2026.
os_greenspace.note: Hairy 100 km tiles overlap. Deduplicate site and access-point identifiers before analysis. A mapped site is not a guarantee of unrestricted public access.

census_lsoa_age.title: Census 2021 TS007a age by five-year age bands, LSOAs
census_lsoa_age.attribution: Contains National Statistics data © Crown copyright and database right.
census_lsoa_age.code_field: Lower Layer Super Output Areas Code
census_lsoa_age.note: 18 disjoint categories. 1 = ages 0–4; 14–18 = ages 65+. Sum the 18 categories for the same-table denominator. Census disclosure control can produce differences across separate tables.

census_oa_age.title: Census 2021 TS007a age by five-year age bands, North West Output Areas
census_oa_age.attribution: Contains National Statistics data © Crown copyright and database right.
census_oa_age.note: Sum all 18 disjoint age categories for routing population weights. These OA totals can differ slightly from separately published LSOA totals because of Census disclosure control.

oa_lookup.attribution: Contains National Statistics data and OS data © Crown copyright and database right.

flood_defended_extents.title: Rivers and Sea defended and undefended flood risk extents - present day
flood_defended_extents.version: Published 25 March 2025; dataset revised 20 May 2026; portal updated 14 August 2026
flood_defended_extents.attribution: © Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2025. All rights reserved.
flood_defended_extents.role: Primary regional flood land-area overlap and scenario sensitivity
flood_defended_extents.note: Uses defended present-day scenarios with defences working as designed. The primary river AEP is 1% and sea AEP is 0.5%; sensitivity is 0.1% for both. Land overlap does not estimate people or properties exposed.

landsat.title: Landsat 8-9 OLI/TIRS Collection 2 Level-2
landsat.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey; distributed by Microsoft Planetary Computer
landsat.version: Collection 2 Level-2; selected scene identifiers and processing versions retained in cached STAC records
landsat.attribution: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 image courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
landsat.temporal_coverage: June-August candidate observations, 2021-2025; accepted dates in metadata/landsat_selection.json
landsat.resolution: 100 m native thermal observations, distributed on a 30 m grid; 100 m analysis grid
landsat.role: Surface-temperature proxy and contextual vegetation index
landsat.note: Clear-sky daytime land-surface temperature is not air temperature or personal heat exposure. Regional QA determines accepted scenes; do not infer a complete five-summer time series from the search interval.

osm_network.title: OpenStreetMap pedestrian network extract, Manchester and Salford with buffer
osm_network.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; data available under ODbL 1.0.
osm_network.role: Walking graph for the Manchester-Salford case study
osm_network.note: The exact Overpass query and snapshot timestamp are stored with the cached extract. Tags and mapped paths can be incomplete; routing does not establish real-world walkability, accessibility or opening hours.

flood_rivers_sea.title: Risk of Flooding from Rivers and Sea, present day
flood_rivers_sea.version: NaFRA2; published January 2025, metadata revised 18 June 2026
flood_rivers_sea.role: Investigated, not used in the analysis
flood_rivers_sea.attribution: © Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2025. All rights reserved.
flood_rivers_sea.note: Includes presence and condition of defences; present-day probability bands. Request a small AOI as GeoPackage, not national GeoJSON.

flood_surface_water.title: Risk of Flooding from Surface Water, present day
flood_surface_water.version: NaFRA2; published January 2025, metadata revised 17 September 2025
flood_surface_water.role: Investigated, not used in the analysis
flood_surface_water.attribution: © Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2025. All rights reserved.
flood_surface_water.note: Use exact risk-category polygons. WMS is rendered cartography and cannot safely be treated as category observations. AOI POST is public; request application/x.gpkg+zip.
